“我们来这里在做什么？太脏，我抱你吧。”凤辞不等时笙反对，直接将她抱起来。

时笙叹气，搂着他的脖子，指挥他往前走。

这是紫竹山外的一处林子，里面瘴气丛生，很多蚊虫飞蛾，脚下还铺着一层厚厚的落叶，腐败之后散发出难闻刺鼻的气味。

时笙来这里，自然是来围观女主的。

叶清秋会在这里得到一个传承，是一种很厉害的功法，在后期能和凤辞正面对上，那个金手指就是作者专门用来对付凤辞的。

作为反派联盟的一员，时笙自然不会让叶清秋得到那个传承。

具体位置时笙不知道，所以她只能在这个时间段来找叶清秋。

“前面有人。”凤辞提醒时笙。

前方是一个小土坡，七歪八扭的长着一些杂草。

凤辞甩了个结界出来，抱着时笙往小土坡上走。

站在小土坡上，下面的场景看得一清二楚。

但是下一秒时笙的眼睛就被捂住了，脑袋还被摁到了凤辞怀里。

小土坡下面的场景很香艳，两个****的男子正在服侍一个女人，女人脸上有伤，一条狰狞的伤疤从左脸斜拉过鼻梁，在右脸嘴角的地方收尾，脸色发白，看上去犹如厉鬼。

但是随着男人在女人身上驰骋，女人脸上的伤竟然慢慢的开始消失，变淡，最后连痕迹都没留下。

“宗主……我不行了。”在女人身上的男人喘息的低吼，动作幅度却越来越大，最后释放在女人体内。

女人将男人一把推开，翻身压在另一个男人身上，主动扭动腰肢。

“宗主，宗主……”被女人推开的男人匍匐到女人面前，目光中带着几分渴望，将自己的分身送到女人面前。

女人一脸嫌恶，抬手一挥，看上去没多大力，男人却直接飞了出去，砸在地上，白花花的身体抽搐了一下，没了生息。

被女人压着的男人见此场景，目光中露出一丝惊恐，下身一下子就软了，女人目光一寒，“废物！”

“宗主不要！”男人抓住女人挥下的手，“我可以的，我真的可以。”

他努力想让自己硬起来，偏偏那里却是软绵绵的，女人等了一会儿，见还没反应，目露杀机，最后却忍住了，她俯下身挑逗男人，好一会儿男人才有了反应。

两人嗯嗯啊啊的不知了多久，等时笙被凤辞放开，下面的两人都已经穿上了衣服，而之前躺地上的人不见了踪影。

时笙捧着脸蛋，漆黑的眸子眨巴了好几下。

她刚才看到的叶清秋脸色那么长一条伤口，看上去也很虚弱。

这和男人翻云覆雨一番，就好了？

哎哟我去，这叶清秋练的不会是传说中的采阳补阴吧？

“宗主……”男人小心翼翼的看着叶清秋，生怕惹她不高兴，落得和另外那个人一样的下场。

"What are we doing here? It's too dirty. Let me hug you." Feng Ci didn't wait for Shi Sheng to object and picked her up directly.

Shi Sheng sighed, put her arms around his neck, and directed him to move forward.

This is a forest outside Zizhu Mountain. It is filled with miasma and there are many mosquitoes and moths. There is also a thick layer of fallen leaves under the feet. After decaying, it emits an unpleasant and pungent smell.

When Shi Sheng came here, he naturally came to watch the heroine.

Ye Qingqiu will get an inheritance here, which is a very powerful skill. In the later stage, he can face Feng Ci head-on. The golden finger is the author's special use to deal with Feng Ci.

As a member of the Villain Alliance, Shi Sheng would naturally not let Ye Qingqiu get that inheritance.

Shi Sheng didn't know the specific location, so she could only come to Ye Qingqiu during this time period.

"There is someone ahead." Feng Ci reminded Shi Sheng.

Ahead is a small slope with some weeds growing here and there.

Feng Ci threw out a barrier and walked up the small slope with Shi Sheng in his arms.

Standing on the small slope, you can see the scene below clearly.

But in the next second, Shi Sheng's eyes were covered and her head was pushed into Feng Ci's arms.

The scene below the small slope is very fragrant. Two naked men are serving a woman. The woman has wounds on her face. A hideous scar stretches diagonally from the left cheek across the bridge of her nose and ends at the corner of her mouth on the right cheek. Her face is pale and she looks like a ghost.

But as the man galloped over the woman's body, the injuries on the woman's face slowly began to disappear and fade, and finally no traces were left.

"Sect Master...I can't do it anymore." The man on the woman gasped and growled, but the range of his movements became larger and larger, and finally he was released into the woman's body.

The woman pushed the man away, turned over and pressed on the other man, and actively twisted her waist.

"Sect Master, Sect Master..." The man who was pushed away by the woman crawled in front of the woman, with a bit of desire in his eyes, and sent his clone to the woman.

With a look of disgust on her face, the woman raised her hand. It didn't look like she was very powerful, but the man flew out directly and hit the ground. His white body twitched and died.

When the man who was being pressed by the woman saw this scene, there was a trace of fear in his eyes, and his lower body suddenly became weak. The woman's eyes turned cold and said, "Trash!"

"Master, I don't want it!" The man grabbed the woman's waving hand, "I can do it, I really can."

He tried hard to get hard, but it was soft there. The woman waited for a while, but when she saw no response, her eyes showed murderous intent, but she finally held back. She leaned down to tease the man, and it took a while for him to respond.

The two of them were talking about each other for who knows how long. When Shi Sheng was let go by Feng Ci, the two people below had already put on their clothes, and the person lying on the ground before was nowhere to be seen.

Shi Sheng held his face and blinked his dark eyes several times.

The Ye Qingqiu she just saw had a long wound on his face and looked very weak.

Is this going to be good with a man?

Oh my gosh, what Ye Qingqiu is practicing isn't the legendary method of gathering yang and replenishing yin, is it?

"Sect Master..." The man looked at Ye Qingqiu cautiously, fearing that he would make her unhappy and end up like the other person.
